verdict.rationale: Financial Connections is an API-first product. The docs show programmatic access to balances, ownership and transactions, a relink API, refresh webhooks, and an official Stripe MCP server that exposes the Stripe API to agents. However, no evidence explicitly claims or demonstrates that every dashboard/UI action has an API equivalent, account linking still requires a client-side authentication flow, and the probed OpenAPI paths returned 404. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity documentation, evidence that dashboard management actions are API-accessible, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Access an account’s current and available balances.
Use the relink API to help your user reconnect their inactive account.
The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
